summary.en: Phone format of about 35 s: opens with a question, one idea, one proof, one takeaway.
summary.de: Handyformat in etwa 35 s: beginnt mit einer Frage, eine Idee, ein Beleg, ein Merksatz.

audience: Viewers scrolling on a phone, usually without sound at first
tone: Warm, direct, calm and curious; no shouting, no superlatives, no countdown urgency

format.unavailable_reason: Needs the vertical 1080x1920 renderer; the panel shows it but does not produce it until that exists.

structure.purpose: THE QUESTION: one open question (at most 12 words) that the video answers, concrete and in the second person
THE GAP: why the question matters, one everyday picture the viewer knows
THE ANSWER: up to three short steps, one picture and one sentence each
THE PROOF: one checkable fact, number or example, with its source named
THE TAKEAWAY: one sentence to remember; its last words lead back to the opening question or to the next one

rules: Sentences of at most 12 words, active voice, verbs before nouns.
One idea per short; a second idea is a second short.
The narration carries the content; each slide shows one headline or one picture, never a paragraph.
Allowed devices: open question, tension arc (question, gap, answer), concrete imagery, rapport wording like "you know this", threefold structure, repeating the takeaway.
avoid: Fear, shame, loss pressure or false urgency.
Hidden commands, hypnotic or trance language, suggestion below awareness.
Invented numbers, invented quotes, a question the video does not answer.
